model: FTW04 BACnet MS/TP RS485 room humidity/temperature unit
applies_to: Thermokon FTW04 BACnet MS/TP RS485 room units (temperature, humidity, optional setpoint, button, rotary switch, LED, 2 digital inputs, 2 analogue outputs).
summary: FTW04 is a wall-mounted room unit with BACnet MS/TP. The interface description lists 28 objects including the device object: room temperature, humidity, setpoint potentiometer, button, digital inputs and rotary switch, two 0-10 V outputs, offsets, setpoint scaling and LED behaviour.
notes: Objects marked # in the description (device offset, offsets, setpoint unit/limits after reset, TempUnit, LED configuration) keep their values after a reset; the # is not part of the name.
Setpoint, button, rotary switch and LED objects only apply to variants that have those parts.
The description has no access column; inputs are listed read-only and values/outputs writable.
Two objects are printed with the same name SetpMIN (and SetpMAX): one is the limit after reset, the other the limit used in operation.

points.name: DeviceOffsetID
points.description: Added to the MAC address to form the device ID

points.name: SetpMIN
points.description: Lower setpoint limit after device reset (default 0)

points.name: SetpMAX
points.description: Upper setpoint limit after device reset (default 100)

points.name: SetpMIN
points.description: Lower setpoint limit, changeable in operation

points.name: SetpMAX
points.description: Upper setpoint limit, changeable in operation

points.name: LockLEDState
points.description: Active: LED toggle via button and digital inputs locked

points.name: ToggleLEDbyDigInput1
points.description: Rising edge on DI1 toggles the LED

points.name: ToggleLEDbyDigInput2
points.description: Rising edge on DI2 toggles the LED

integration.summary: Read the temperature and humidity, the setpoint potentiometer and the button/digital inputs; the BMS can drive the two 0-10 V outputs and the LED.
setup: Baud rate 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600 or 76800 and MAC address are set on DIP switches.
Device ID = DeviceOffsetID (default 100) + MAC address; the device restarts after either is changed.
gotchas: Device profile is B-SA with only ReadProperty and WriteProperty.
